entries.title: Psalms 64:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Hear my voice, O God, in my meditation; Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

entries.title: Psalms 64:2
segments: Hide me from the secret plots of the wicked, From the rebellion of the workers of iniquity,

entries.title: Psalms 64:3
segments: Who sharpen their tongue like a sword, And bend [their bows to shoot] their arrows-bitter words,

entries.title: Psalms 64:4
segments: That they may shoot in secret at the blameless; Suddenly they shoot at him and do not fear.

entries.title: Psalms 64:5
segments: They encourage themselves [in] an evil matter; They talk of laying snares secretly; They say, "Who will see them?"

entries.title: Psalms 64:6
segments: They devise iniquities: "We have perfected a shrewd scheme." Both the inward thought and the heart of man are deep.

entries.title: Psalms 64:7
segments: ¶But God shall shoot at them [with] an arrow; Suddenly they shall be wounded.

entries.title: Psalms 64:8
segments: So He will make them stumble over their own tongue; All who see them shall flee away.

entries.title: Psalms 64:9
segments: All men shall fear, And shall declare the work of God; For they shall wisely consider His doing.

entries.title: Psalms 64:10
segments: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and trust in Him. And all the upright in heart shall glory.
